Tuition Fee Concessions
TUITION FEE CONCESSIONS: 2024-25
A) Award of Scholarship:
The following criteria based on percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying examination will be applicable during the first semester only for the newly admitted UG & PG students for the Academic Session 2024-25 subject to payment of full Tuition Fee for a semester or for a year:
95% & above:
75% of the Tuition Fee
90% to
<
95% :
50% of the Tuition Fee
80% to
<
90% :
30% of the Tuition Fee
70% to
<
80% :
10% of the Tuition Fee
B) The tuition fee waiver rules:
For the real two sisters, it will be as under:
Till the period both the sisters studying in the University : 50% tuition fee will be waived off to the first elder sister.
Once the first sister passes out from the University : 100% tuition fee will be paid by the  second sister till the completion of the course.
C)
100% tuition fee waiver for the duration of degree course to the students whose parents (Both Mother & Father) have lost their life due to Covid-19 pandemic.
D)
25% tuition fee waiver for the duration of degree course will also be applicable for the following categories:
Wards of Defence personnel i.e. (Army/Air Force/Navy/Para Military Forces) both either serving or retired.
Wards of the Freedom Fighters.
Single girl child.
However, such student as categorised in clause (C) & (D) above, at the time of admission and in consecutive semester/years of the degree course will not be entitled for other scholarship on the merit basis as approved earlier.
